# DRAFT for root (S3 bazel_graph lane). Not applied: .github/workflows/ci.yml is root-owned.
# Insert under `jobs:` beside `offline`. Optional and non-blocking until root has seen it green.
# The hosted ubuntu-24.04 image ships bazelisk as `bazel`; .bazelversion selects 8.2.1.
# No remote cache, no credentials, no media, no model downloads.
  bazel:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 45
    continue-on-error: true
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
      - name: Structural graph contract (no Bazel needed)
        run: PYTHONPATH=tests python3 -m unittest test_bazel_graph_s3 -v
      - name: Rust crates and tests through Bazel
        run: python3 tools/bazel/run.py --timeout 1800 test //:rust_tests //src:all //native/au-spike:all
      - name: Stdlib Python tests through Bazel
        run: python3 tools/bazel/run.py --timeout 1800 test //tests:python_stdlib
      # Add once web/pnpm-workspace.yaml carries `allowBuilds`:
      #   python3 tools/bazel/run.py --timeout 900 mod graph
      #   python3 tools/bazel/run.py --timeout 1800 test //web:svelte_check_test
      #   python3 tools/bazel/run.py --timeout 1800 build //web:build
